status: Complete M3 application matrix accepted on host; native BBOS qualification remains separate
environment: Production phone canvas/controller/session/renderer/mixer with headless LCDUI/filesystem/RMS/audio adapters. Original synthetic guest gradient, input sampler and left-only fixed-volume square tone; synthetic external reset-vector BIOS.
ownership: One emulation owner; audio packets and presented frames are owned copies. The output test uses a bounded 128-packet queue that fails on overflow. Guest inspection loads only committed owned slot bytes.
playback_acceptance: Observe a real guest-generated left-only PSG tone at the default output volume; change volume through UI and verify the PCM amplitude.
Switch stereo to mono through UI; every output pair matches and its amplitude reflects averaging.
Mute produces no output packets. Exercise 2x/4x/8x/1x with mute enabled and disabled; acceleration stays silent and returning to 1x preserves the independent mute choice.
Use the production PhoneRenderer/MidpGraphics through the running canvas in all four scaling modes; every one of the 38400 guest pixels remains represented, including the final row/column.
Enable FPS and presentation skip 1 in 6. The GBA counter becomes numeric; fewer submitted frames still execute every guest frame and transport every produced PCM frame without overruns/underruns.
Recreate the controller and start the game with persisted volume, mono, mute, skip, FPS, scaling, boot and speed preferences.
control_lifecycle_extension: Combine shoulder locks, A and Right before pausing and confirming Restart; late physical releases do not leave the restarted guest holding keys.
Change to another ROM file while physical action/direction keys were held and R was locked before pause; the new guest sees every key released.
Save the new game separately and retain the previous game committed slot bytes.

fixture_pcm_expectations.master_tone: Fixed-volume square, left route only, full PSG ratio; frontend expectations, not independent GBA DAC qualification

scaling_geometry_at_640x480.verification: Sample one rendered destination representing each source coordinate and compare all 240x160 RGB values with the owned guest frame; no overlays enabled during this check.

frame_skip_verification.checks: Executed guest frames are between 1+6*(submitted-1) and 6*submitted; one owned PCM packet per guest frame, total packet sample count equals the guest produced-PCM counter delta, overruns/underruns zero. This checks policy, not physical performance.

harness_changes: Observe the emulation owner thread at its paused mailbox wait before measuring a new test window. This read-only host barrier avoids racing a finishing frame/preference application and submits no hidden guest command.
Capture only owned output packets and render through the actual canvas adapter; expose completed storage reads for a specifically identified second ROM file.

m3_coverage.slots_battery_and_legacy: benchmarks/phone-library-slots-acceptance-2026-11-19.json; existing PhoneStorageInterruptionTest and PhoneSessionTest retain independent battery/storage coverage
m3_coverage.controls: benchmarks/phone-controls-acceptance-2026-11-19.json plus the restart/game-change extension in this record
m3_coverage.qualification: All six current combined UI test methods pass together, plus existing host and exported regression suites. Host policy/storage acceptance does not establish BBOS runtime or physical presentation/audio.

native_target_checks: Install and open the app, browse actual phone storage/BIOS and play/pause/load.
Actual device key rollover, file permissions, MMAPI transport/latency and sustained performance.
next_milestone: M4: isolated active-scene profiles from the Golden Sun, Sonic and LeafGreen M2 recordings at 1x, full sound and no emulator frame skips; guest work, allocations/GC, queue bounds and produced/consumed PCM.
limits: Core and phone runtime sources are unchanged; this update completes host integration acceptance of already implemented features.
RMS and audio transport are host adapters. No physical FPS, MMAPI playback or OS process-restart durability claim.
The FPS check observes a host wall-clock policy counter; it is not a Bold performance measurement or an isolated M4 baseline.
The previously built SDK/actual-CLDC core validation is retained; no native package, tag or release is produced here.
